# Aydin Ayanzadeh

> Official personal site of Aydin Ayanzadeh, Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC). Research focuses on computer vision, medical image analysis, multimodal / vision-language models, and accessibility AI.

## Canonical identity
- Name: Aydin Ayanzadeh
- Website: https://www.ayanzadeh.com/
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8816-3204
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=B17tai4AAAAJ
- Email: a.ayanzadeh@gmail.com / aydina1@umbc.edu

## Key pages
- [Home / portfolio](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/): biography, publications, projects, CV
- [Publications](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/publications.html): peer-reviewed papers and preprints
- [Projects](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/projects/): FloorPlan2Guide, WildfireVLM, medical segmentation, and more
- [AI Skills Bank](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/projects/ai-skills-bank.html): 500 reusable AI skills with stable IDs for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Kimi CLI, Aider and Cline
- [Skills catalog](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/skills/): searchable catalog of all 500 skills, one card per skill with a copy-ready prompt
- [Contact](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/contact.html): collaboration contact details
- [Blog](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/blog.html): research notes
- [CV (PDF)](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/Aydin_Ayanzadeh_CV__final.pdf)

## Machine-readable indexes
- [skills.json](https://www.ayanzadeh.com/skills/skills.json): every skill as JSON (id, name, description, category, source file), schema version 1
- Upstream source: https://github.com/Ayanzadeh93/Claude-Skills-Bank (MIT) — same 500 skills as Markdown, plus packs for six AI coding CLIs
- Skill IDs are stable and ASCII: `AS`, `CS`, `CR`, `DS`, `ES`, `GS`, `OS`, `PS`, `RS`, `WS`, each followed by a three-digit number (e.g. `CS-009` = Code Review Partner)

## Human-subjects research
- Principal Investigator, UMBC IRB Protocol #1743 — InVLM: VLM-Based Indoor Navigation System for People with Visual Impairments (Expedited Human-Subjects Research, approved May 2025). See https://www.ayanzadeh.com/projects/indoor-navigation.html
